# invariants-sidecar

> Library-declared invariants as verified data: a static-land dictionary completer (derive `map`, `ap`, … from a minimal base) plus a law/consistency property-test generator targeting tape-six-fast-check's `t.prop()`, and a sidecar-artifact toolchain — parser (inert data), check compiler (explicit trust step), call-site guards, apodictum oracle bridge. Zero runtime dependencies; claims are verified, never trusted.

## Install

npm install --save-dev invariants-sidecar tape-six tape-six-fast-check fast-check

## Quick start — static-land laws

```js
import test from 'tape-six';
import fc from 'fast-check';
import 'tape-six-fast-check';
import {complete, makeLawTests, makeConsistencyTests, runLaws} from 'invariants-sidecar';

const {module: M, derived, consistency} = complete(Maybe); // minimal base in, full module out

const opts = {
  arb: fc.oneof(fc.constant(NOTHING), fc.integer().map(Maybe.of)),
  arbA: fc.integer(),
  arbFn: fc.func(fc.integer())
};

test('Maybe laws', async t => {
  await runLaws(t, makeLawTests(M, opts));
  await runLaws(t, makeConsistencyTests(Maybe, opts));
});
```

Law sets: Setoid, Semigroup, Monoid, Functor, Applicative, Chain, Monad.
Lifted values default to `of`-lifting; supply `arbK`/`arbUF` to reach values `of` cannot build.

## Quick start — sidecar artifacts

```js
import {isSidecar, parseSidecar, compileChecks} from 'invariants-sidecar';

if (!isSidecar(text)) return; // a prose INVARIANTS.md — the filename proves nothing
const sidecar = parseSidecar(text); // inert data — nothing is evaluated
const checks = compileChecks(sidecar); // explicit trust step — compiles, doesn't invoke
// checks['pre:partitioned'](...) / checks['post:partition-point'](...) inside t.prop properties
```

Frontmatter is strict and is the only discriminator: `sidecar` (format version, an integer in the file; read it back as the number `parseSidecar(text).version`, since frontmatter values are raw strings), `package` (must equal the host package's name), `binds` (versions the claims are asserted for) are required; `export` and `verified: ci` are optional. `INVARIANTS.md` is widely used for human prose and for agent guardrails, so a file without those keys is prose, not a contract.

## API surface (all named exports)

- `complete(module)` → `{module, derived, consistency}` — derive every missing derivable method to fixpoint; `DERIVATIONS` is the lattice.
- `lawsFor(T, typeclasses?)` / `LAWS` — applicable law records.
- `makeLawTests(T, opts)` / `makeConsistencyTests(T, opts)` → `LawTest[]`; `runLaws(t, tests)` drives them through `t.prop`.
- `parseSidecar(text)` → `Sidecar` — moonshot §6.5 vocabulary in the §6.6 format, to inert data; loud, located errors, including frontmatter that does not identify a sidecar.
- `isSidecar(text)` / `readFrontmatter(text)` / `sidecarProblems(frontmatter)` / `SIDECAR_VERSION` — the discriminator, and why a file failed it. Never throw. Frontmatter values are raw strings (`fm.sidecar` is `"1"`); the typed version is `parseSidecar(text).version`, which is what `SIDECAR_VERSION` compares against.
- `resolveSidecar(read)` (subpath `invariants-sidecar/resolve.js`) → `{path, via, sidecar, version, binds, stale, verified}` | `{path, skipped}` | `null` — §6.6 discovery for an installed package: manifest `invariants` key, else root `INVARIANTS.md`. Takes a reader over the package directory, so it imports no node builtins. `satisfies(version, range)` handles exact/`^`/`~`/`*` and returns null for forms it does not implement.
- `compileCheck(check)` / `compileChecks(sidecar)` — checks as callables, keyed `kind:name`.
- `lawTestsFromSidecar(sidecar, module, opts)` — a Laws section (`implements:` + custom `law:` checks) as a law suite.
- `guardsFromSidecar(sidecar, opts?)` (subpath `invariants-sidecar/guards.js`, requires tape-six-invariant) — check-bearing `pre:` claims as call-site guards.
- `oracleInputsFromSidecar(sidecar, opts?)` / `instantiateAxioms(axioms, binding)` / `declareFromSidecar(declares, symbolExports)` — blessed `law:`/`effects:` claims as `apodictum` oracle wire shapes (not a dependency). Yields nothing unless the sidecar carries `verified: ci`, returning `unverified: true` instead; `{allowUnverified: true}` reads it as a proposal.

## Notes

- ES modules only; no build step; `.d.ts` sidecars carry all types + docs.
- Full API reference: llms-full.txt. Repo: https://github.com/uhop/invariants-sidecar
